mapper.sql: id, user_id, order_number, channel_payment_id, channel_type, amount, pay_type, pay_status, extend_str, pay_end_time, gmt_created, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qinghe_payment_record (id, user_id, order_number, channel_payment_id, channel_type, amount, pay_type, pay_status, extend_str, pay_end_time, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{orderNumber}, #{channelPaymentId}, #{channelType}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{payStatus}, #{extendStr}, #{payEndTime}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM qinghe_payment_record WHERE pay_status = #{payStatus} ORDER BY gmt_created DESC
